summary: Frontend retest of the receipt search in ReceiptArchive.tsx at 390x844, logged in as merchant mer-1 (temporarily set to law_office, with 7 seeded signed stops over 3 dates). All 27 search queries returned the expected rows. Multi-word and mixed searches now match: 'October 27', '27 Oct', 'Oct 27 2025', 'Oct 27, 2025', 'johnson oct', '2025-10-27 alice', 'Alice  Johnson' with two spaces, and '2025/10/27'. Single-term searches still match: partial name, partial and full code, ISO, D/M/Y and M/D/Y dates, 'october', 'Sept', 'Sep', and any case. Time of day is no longer searchable: 'p.m.', 'a.m.', '45' and '40' return 0 rows; '3' returns only the Nov 3 rows; '15' returns only Sep 15. The placeholder fits. The 48x48 clear button shows only when there is text, and tapping it empties the input, brings back the 5-row list and hides the count. Regression checks all passed: the 'N OF 7 MATCH' count, the empty message, no 5-row cap while searching, the SHOW ALL 7 / SHOW FEWER toggle (hidden while searching), PDF on a filtered row (application/pdf, 200) and DOWNLOAD ALL 7 (ZIP) (application/zip, 200).

issues: LOW: The search ignores a trailing period, so 'Oct.' or 'Sept.' (common en-CA forms, and how the row label reads, e.g. 'Sep 15') return 0 rows. Fix: strip '.' from each term, or keep the dotted short month in searchText.

LOW: Each word is matched as a substring, so 'Oct 2' matches every Oct 27 row ('2' is in '27' and '2025'), and '7' matches day 27 and codes ending in 7. This is acceptable for a simple search; only change it if exact day matching is wanted.

LOW: While a search is active the button still reads 'DOWNLOAD ALL 7 (ZIP)'. This is correct (it downloads every receipt), but a user might expect only the filtered set. Consider a hint or a 'download N matches' option.

action_items: OPTIONAL LOW: Strip '.' from search terms so 'Oct.' and 'Sept.' match, e.g. terms = needle.replace(/\./g, '').split(/[\s,]+/)... (note this would let 'p.m.' become 'pm', which is still harmless because time is not indexed).
critical_code_review_comments: ReceiptArchive.tsx is 109 lines. The search index is memoised on q.data, matching is case-insensitive, and the clear button has an accessibilityLabel and a 48x48 touch target. No issues found.
seed_data_creation: Temporary seed: mer-1 business_type=law_office plus 7 signed delivered stops TSRS100-106. All were removed afterwards and mer-1 was restored from a snapshot (business_type and signature_required unset). The probe script was kept in /tmp and deleted; nothing was added to tests/.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To seed: snapshot mer-1, set business_type=law_office, and insert stops with merchant_id=mer-1, status=delivered, pod_signature set, route_id=None and delivered_at at midday UTC. Restore with replace_one. Capture the PDF and ZIP through context request/response listeners, because the popup opens as about:blank. The tracking codes TSRS10x all contain '10', so the query '10' matches all 7 rows by design.
